Nora: Quick flag - healthscore spikes for ~600 accounts after last night's CRM backfill. Looks like duplicate 'enablement_completed' events.
Ben: Any sample payloads?
Nora: Example: acct_pine: two payloads, identical except second has null event_guid.
Sasha: Root cause likely older backfill rows missing event_guid -> playbook-runner fires twice. Can we add a lightweight fingerprint check at runner? e.g., sha1(account_id|event_type|round_min(event_ts)).
Omar: Also: backfill should stamp `idempotency_key`. Small writer change plus runner guard = safe.
csops-bot: ALERT: backfill-queue length=42k retries=4 (00:12 UTC).
Ben: Plan: 1) run targeted dedupe collapsing duplicates by fingerprint; 2) deploy runner guard with 1h TTL; 3) add quick health-corrections for large deltas.
Sasha: I'll open PR for runner guard (branch: cs/guard-fp). Unit tests included.
Nora: I'll export top 200 affected accounts and tag AE leads for suppression of renewal outreach.
Omar: I'll implement idempotency_key on backfill writer and coordinate deploy.
csops-bot: ACTION: ticket CS-7121 created "CRM backfill duplicates -> healthscore inflation" Assigned: Nora, Sasha, Omar.
Ben: Approve dedupe + guard + idempotency deploy. Runbook update after retro.
Nora: Deploying dedupe dry-run now, will post results shortly. :thumbsup:
